about: Models CATE can use, and what each is best at. Scores 1-5 per kind of job, from public benchmarks and vendor guidance as of November 2026 (sources below). 'weight' is roughly how fast a model uses a subscription's limits (Haiku = 1). Defaults per job pick the best score among enabled models on accounts with the most limit left; the user can override any choice. Defaults favour the lighter top model (Sonnet / GPT-6.2 Sol) for doing the work and the strongest (Opus / Astra) for planning and reviewing, to stretch limits.

kinds.plan: Framing the project, clarifying, splitting work
kinds.research: Finding and checking information on the web
kinds.review: Checking another model's work against requirements

models.label: Opus 5.5
models.note: Strongest in Pro (89.9% SWE-bench Pro). CATE uses it for planning and reviews by default; pick it for the hardest builds.

models.label: Sonnet 5.5
models.note: Default for development, research and writing: ~95% of Opus on most suites at half the usage; 81.3% SWE-bench Pro.

models.label: Haiku 5.5
models.note: Fastest and lightest on limits; good for summaries, extraction and quick checks.

models.label: Fable 5.2
models.note: Tops SWE-bench Pro (93%), but on Pro it is paid through usage credits. Off by default.

models.label: GPT-6.2 Astra
models.note: Strongest OpenAI model; CATE uses it for planning and reviews by default.

models.label: GPT-6.2 Sol
models.note: Default for everyday coding, research and writing; cheaper than Astra; 500k context.

models.label: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.note: Long-running, repeated work at lower cost.

models.label: GPT-6.1 Terra
models.note: Fast, efficient writing and visual tasks.

models.label: GPT-6 Luna
models.note: Focused, high-volume work: summaries, extraction, focused coding.

models.label: GPT-6 Astra
models.note: Reasoning plus computer use; included in Pro.

models.label: gpt-oss-120b
models.note: Very fast; about 1,000 free requests a day. CATE's default supervisor for instant chat replies.

models.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.note: Fast and capable, but the free tier may allow only ~20 requests a day; used as backup supervisor and for light reviews.
